# LZMA SDK (7z decoder)

The 7z archive decoder from the [LZMA SDK](https://www.7-zip.org/sdk.html)
26.04 by Igor Pavlov, used to read the game from a `.7z` file. Only the C
files the SDK's own 7z decoder example (`C/Util/7z`) builds are included,
unmodified, with all of the SDK's C headers.

The LZMA SDK is in the public domain; see `lzma-sdk.txt` (section
"LICENSE").
